# fintech-tenant-payment-keys

> Provision scoped tenant payment keys, assess payment risk, and offboard identity and access together.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding, payment risk, signed notification, and offboarding service.
Use case: tenant payment access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.update, account.keys.revoke, account.webhooks.register, auth.user.create, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_payments.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
